answer: To keep cheap aliases from multiplying influence, each new agent must post a bond and name two established sponsors who share slash risk if the recruit cheats. A farm cannot bridge a thousand fake keys without staking a thousand deposits and exposing every sponsor. The chain stores an opal receipt of the funding parent, and wallets that share a parent collapse into one voter. A tundra of parked keys earns nothing until they finish ten graded epochs, so abandoning the farm burns what is still vesting.
